items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Jim Crow was with them. Jim Crow used to play banjo before he started playing trombone... But he played with Sam Morgan a long while.

ctx.x: Well, he had a, other boys, he had a, Jim Crow was with them. Jim Crow used to play banjo before he started playing trombone, you know.
I knew he played guitar. I didn't know he played banjo.
